hash_recording: All member and derived-file hashes were computed during candidate preparation, not asserted to be original runtime metadata.
config_adaptation: Historical data/output locations are opaque aliases; protocol wording replaces user-oriented wording. Scientific values and parameter-source evidence are retained. These configuration records are evidence, not directly executable path configurations.

partition_identity: Logical protocol identity only; per-sample membership is not distributed or independently hash-identified.
